➖2️⃣ ELI5 Kata · NegaBinary (λ-Calculus, 2 kyu)

In base -2 (used in 1950s Polish BINEG computers!), every bit multiplies by -2 (`E x = -2x`, `O x = 1 - 2x`), representing + and - numbers with NO sign bit!

https://github.com/8b-is/space-bender/tree/main/katas/2kyu/negabinary

🪞 ELI5 Step 1 (1-Step Sign-Flip Unrolling):

Because multiplying by -2 flips the sign at every bit:
• `pred (E x) = O (succ x)` & `pred (O x) = mkE x`
• `lt0 n` is just `gt0` of the tail!
• `hlf n = n Zero neg neg` (floor ÷2 in 1 line)!
Zero mutual-recursion forward refs needed!

➗ ELI5 Step 2 (BinaryScott Bridge & Deferred `()`):

In base -2, `mul` needs no subtraction (`(1-2x)n = n + E(x*n)`).
For `div`, `mod`, `gcd`, `lcm`, we bridge `|m|, |n|` in O(log n) to unsigned `BinaryScott` long division and wrap error `()` in `\_.()`!

✅ All 47 exports & 49 test suites verified in ~730 ms (vs 5s limit)!
